name: Janome
title: Janome Sewing Machines UK: Range, History and Servicing
description: Janome sewing machines: the meaning of the name, the brand’s history since 1921, why schools and home sewers choose it, and how to get parts and servicing.
intro: Dependable domestic machines with a strong following in UK homes, schools and colleges.

image.alt: White and blue domestic sewing machine

cardText: History since 1921, the “snake’s eye” bobbin, and who Janome suits.

sections.html: The company was founded in Japan in 1921. “Janome” means “snake’s eye”, a reference to the round bobbin design that was a feature of its early machines.
Janome is known for straightforward, reliable machines. Mechanical and computerised models are common in schools and with beginners; larger models with extra throat space appeal to quilters.
Janome also makes overlockers and coverstitch machines for home sewers who want professional finishes on knits.
